title: Workout schedule response (schedule_workout)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's schedule_workout(workout_id, date_str), which POSTs {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"} to workout-service/schedule/<workoutId>. Called by sync_pending_workouts (via _schedule_uploaded_workout) for a create_workout queue item carrying schedule_date; only workoutScheduleId is read (for logging). get_scheduled_workout_by_id(workoutScheduleId) returns the same top-level shape.

Verified against: 2026-10-17, two live calls scheduling a real uploaded running workout (one kept, one a probe removed via unschedule_workout, which returns {}). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true).

workoutScheduleId.description: Id of this calendar entry — what unschedule_workout and get_scheduled_workout_by_id take. Distinct from workout.workoutId (the library workout), which can be scheduled on many days.

workout.description: The scheduled library workout — same shape as upload_workout's / get_workout_by_id's response (workoutId, workoutName, sportType, workoutSegments, ...). Not read by sync.py.

associatedActivityId.description: observed null — presumably set once an activity completes this workout; not captured.
